claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b085] Scope decisions for this file, which covers lines 132-247 only; lines 1-131 of the same document are batch b084's assignment and were read for context only. Out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5 and therefore not extracted: Obs identifiers (Obs 296, 300, 301, 302); the map-sheet names (K-35-067-2 and siblings), the '1981' in 'Soviet 1981 edition', and the raster path `inputs/rasters/Russian1981_32635/`, all of which are edition or path identifiers; the run labels 'T=0.3', 'T=0.7', 'text-MIN' and 'image', which name conditions rather than assert temperatures; and the '(50, 75] m' shell bounds, which identify the annulus rather than assert a measured quantity — note that the anchor does record them at $.shell_inner_m / $.shell_outer_m should triage prefer to treat them as claims. 'top-3' is treated as a set label for the per-run high-pull triple rather than a claim, because the selection rule it names is stated in the document's Methods section at lines 55-56 (batch b084's range). Bare determiners ('both groups', 'a single detection', 'only K-35-051-3') are not extracted, but counts spelled as words ('nine high-pull maps', 'four runs', 'Twelve maps', 'All three sheets', 'two ... mechanisms') are, with the more rhetorical ones flagged individually. Anchor note: the document names its two sources in its Methods and Provenance sections — results/55maps-per-map-shell-variance/per_map_shell_rates.json (per-map shell rates, run keys 't0.3' / 't0.7' / 'image' / 'text-min') and results/55maps-fp-classification/fp_classifications.json (a flat array of per-FP records keyed by map_name) — and both are used as anchors here. Per-map false-positive totals, medians, and group ranges require a scripted group-by over the latter and are recorded as recompute-script.

claims.notes: Borderline inclusion, flagged for possible pruning: 'All three sheets' counts the three map sheets named in the immediately preceding sentence, so it is a self-referential prose count rather than a measured quantity, and no artefact enumerates this comparison set. source.section: Cross-cut analysis — Image-track and text-track tails do not overlap meaningfully

claims.claim_text:
This near-disjoint structure
is consistent with two qualitatively different mechanisms by track (per Obs 301:
image-track is uniformly distributed across all maps; text-track is bimodal
with a sparse high-pull tail), rather than with a single shared cartographic
mechanism.

values.quantity: count, distinct distractor-pull mechanisms posited by track

claims.notes: Borderline inclusion, flagged for possible pruning: 'two qualitatively different mechanisms' is an interpretive count of proposed explanations, not a measured quantity, and no artefact can decide it. Included because rule 4 of the task instrument prefers over-inclusion to omission.
